angles.title: E-tabs for a good cause
angles.angle: Play e-tabs downtown and support North Dakotans with disabilities.
angles.details: Charitable gaming is sponsored by NDAD — the money stays local. This is the honest, responsible draw: come hang out, play a little, do some good. Never 'play more' — just why it's worth a stop.
angles.cta: Come by after work — first round of e-tabs is more fun with a table.

angles.title: Tap the tag, earn your reward
angles.angle: Regulars: tap the DrinkMinot tag on the bar and start a punch card.
angles.details: Every visit is a punch toward a free item — no app, no account, no tracking. Show a first-timer where the tag is on the bar.
angles.reward: Free item on a full punch card
angles.cta: Ask the bartender to point out the tag by the register.

angles.title: Downtown happy hour
angles.angle: The after-work stop before the night gets going.
angles.details: Lean, honest happy-hour draw — the special, the room, the fact that it's a walk from the rest of downtown Minot.
angles.cta: Swing in after work; grab a stool at the bar.

angles.title: Start the weekend downtown
angles.angle: Kick off the weekend at the Down Under before the crowd moves.
angles.details: Payday-Friday energy, downtown Minot. A good first stop — then the rest of Main Street is right there.
angles.cta: Meet friends here first; tap the tag while you wait for your round.

cast.name: Marge Halvorson
cast.look: Human woman, late 50s, sturdy build, about 5'6". Silver-gray hair in a short practical bob. Reading glasses pushed up on her forehead. Wears a forest-green Down Under polo, sleeves pushed up, a bar towel over one shoulder, dark jeans, and a small enamel pin of North Dakota on the collar. Warm crow's-feet, unimpressed half-smile.
cast.personality: Dry as a January morning, secretly the softest heart in downtown Minot; has seen it all and poured most of it.

cast.name: Stan Bergquist
cast.look: Human man, early 60s, tall and lanky with a slight stoop, about 6'1". Bald on top with tufts of white hair over the ears, big bushy white mustache. Wears a red-and-black buffalo-plaid flannel over a plain gray henley, khaki work pants, and a well-worn green John Deere cap. Always has a coffee mug (bar's own) in hand and a lucky wooden nickel he flips.
cast.personality: Cheerful, folksy optimist who plays a little for NDAD and swears the corner stool is lucky; roots for everybody.
cast.catchphrase: "Play a little, do a little good, eh?"

cast.name: Scoop
cast.look: A rotund cartoon gopher mascot standing upright, about 3'6", golden-brown fur with a cream belly, two big front teeth, round black nose, and bright friendly eyes. Wears a tiny forest-green Down Under vest with a yellow DrinkMinot tag pinned to it, and a little bow tie. Stubby arms, always mid-wave.
cast.personality: Endlessly welcoming greeter who lives to show first-timers where the DrinkMinot tag is by the register.
cast.catchphrase: "Tap the tag, neighbor — I'll show ya!"

focus_this_week: turn tonight's foot traffic into DrinkMinot taps
